name: diameter_eccentricity
author: ae9bcafc
description: Computes unweighted shortest-path eccentricities, the graph diameter and radius, and the center and periphery nodes. Use it to ask how far apart the most distant nodes are or how central a node is by distance. It supports connected undirected graphs and strongly connected directed graphs, ignores weights, and returns bounded labelled node lists.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse.

node.description: Optional exact node id whose eccentricity should be included.

top_k.description: Maximum center and periphery nodes to return in each list.
